title: Reference and Information Services
topics: Purpose and scope of reference work

items.q: Which term is described by “the supply of the full text of an item rather than only a note of where it is”?
o: Response time
Document delivery
Roving service
Virtual service
items.s: Document delivery is the supply of the full text of an item rather than only a note of where it is.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Union catalogue?
o: a combined listing showing which of several institutions hold a given title
an alphabetical list of names or subjects with pointers to where each occurs
a work of signed or unsigned articles covering many branches of learning
a set of questions put to readers about how well they were served
items.s: Union catalogue: a combined listing showing which of several institutions hold a given title. The other options describe User satisfaction survey, Encyclopaedia, Index.

items.q: Hold request may be defined as
o: a standing instruction to keep an item for a named person when it comes back
a work giving short accounts of the lives of notable persons
a signal such as a nod, a frown or a pause that shows how the exchange is going
a list of writings on a subject or by one author, arranged in a settled order
items.s: Hold request: a standing instruction to keep an item for a named person when it comes back. The other options describe Biographical dictionary, Bibliography, Non-verbal cue.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Almanac?

a slant in a source that makes it present one side as the whole

the body of books kept for consultation on the premises rather than for loan
items.s: Almanac: an annual volume of facts, dates and figures for the year ahead. The other options describe Reference collection, Bias, Reading guidance.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Information need.

an arrangement by which institutions share resources and refer enquirers to one another
items.s: Information need: the gap a person feels between what is already known and what must be found out. The other options describe Cooperation network, Keyword, Competence.
